name: Alexandre Pantoja

tale_of_tape.source: data/derived/fighters.json (65 in height, 67 in reach); 125 lb at the UFC 331 weigh-in (Sep 2026)

photo_coverage: Good. Current (Sep 2026) studio headshot and cutout, a Dec 2025 cutout, a large Dec 2025 frontal face (Commons, CC BY 3.0), two left-side profiles and two three-quarter faces from UFC 331 fight week (Aug-Sep 2026), a weigh-in body shot and two fight shots (one from behind). Two Commons files are freely licensed (2023 and 2025 interview stills); the rest are reference-only.

face.shape: Lean, angular, rectangular-oval face of medium length; gaunt at fight weight, with hollow cheeks and visible cheekbones.
face.jaw: Angular and well defined, of medium width; the jaw angle shows through the short beard.
face.chin: Medium and slightly squared, moderately projecting, with a dark soul-patch strip under the lower lip.
face.cheekbones: Prominent and fairly high, with deep hollows under them at fight weight and vertical creases in the cheeks.
face.brow_ridge: Heavy. The brows sit low and close to the eyes, giving a permanent frown.
face.forehead: High, with deep temple recession (M-shaped hairline) and horizontal lines.

eyes.shape: Deep-set, narrow almond with heavy, hooded upper lids; mild under-eye bags

eyebrows.shape: Straight and low, nearly meeting over the nose (small gap), angled slightly down toward the centre

nose.tip: Broad, rounded, slightly bulbous, with wide nostrils
nose.fight_damage: The bridge looks flattened and slightly crooked (it leans a little to his left in the ESPN headshot), consistent with old breaks.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width. Thin upper lip, fuller lower lip; corners turn slightly down at rest.

ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears: the inner folds (antihelix and concha) are thickened and lumpy, more so on the left ear (ESPN headshot zoom; also visible in the 2025 Commons still).
ears.note: They stand out slightly from the head.

face.notable_marks_scars: Small scars around the brows; a fresh cut between the brows in the Jul 2023 interview (healed since). Deep forehead lines.

hair.style: Very short, even buzz cut (about 0.3-0.6 cm) with deeply receded temples. In Jul 2023 it was longer (6-8 cm) and wavy.
hair.colour_note: Dark brown with some grey. The raw ESPN sample from the top of the head is #78513e because scalp shows through; render the strands darker.
hair.hairline: M-shaped, deeply receded at both temples
hair.texture: Short and straight (wavy when grown out, 2023)

facial_hair.detail: Short, even beard about 0.5-1 cm long over the jaw, chin and upper lip, with a clean cheek line and a defined dark soul patch. Clearly salt-and-pepper: dark on the moustache and soul patch, grey-flecked on the chin and jaw. Clean-shaven in Jul 2023.
facial_hair.colour_note: Raw ESPN chin sample #503b33; grey-lit strands #896352. Mix about 25-35% grey hairs into a dark brown base on the chin and jaw.
facial_hair.density: medium-dense, greyer and patchier on the chin
facial_hair.shape: boxed short beard with a soul patch

skin.tone_hex_method: plain RGB mean of the samples marked in_average (well-lit, near-neutral cheek and forehead-free patches); each sample is the median of the 25th-65th luma percentile pixels of the patch
skin.freckles_marks: No obvious freckles; some shine on the forehead. Little chest hair; hairy legs.
skin.note: The webcam (pink, overexposed) and Cageside presser (magenta cast) samples are excluded. In the same ESPN studio setup his cheeks (#d8875f, #cb7c56) are clearly darker and more golden than Shevchenko's (#e68a70, #ea8f73), so keep him a medium tan.

body.build: Small, compact and very lean flyweight: 165 cm, 57 kg (125 lb) at weigh-in.
body.body_fat_note: Very lean: sharp six-pack, obliques and serratus, veins on the forearms.
body.shoulders: Moderately broad for his size, rounded delts
body.chest: Flat, defined pectorals with a clear lower line
body.arms: Lean and sinewy with veiny forearms; reach 170 cm (5 cm more than height)
body.legs_calves: Lean, muscular thighs and well-defined calves; hairy legs
body.notable: Gaunt face and body at weigh-in; very little fat anywhere.

tattoos.where: left arm (full sleeve), left shoulder and upper left chest
tattoos.description: Colour Japanese-style (irezumi) sleeve: a dragon head with red and black detail over the left shoulder, framed by black sunburst rays that reach the collarbone and upper chest; the scaled dragon body winds down the upper arm; clouds, waves, roses and flames fill the forearm down to the wrist. Mostly black shading with red accents.

tattoos.where: right thigh, just below the shorts hem
tattoos.description: Japanese-style cloud/wave linework in black outline (ESPN Dec 2025 cutout); the rest is hidden by the shorts

tattoos_note: Right arm, back (seen from behind at UFC 331) and right chest are clear.

kit.fight_shorts: Black Venum shorts with a red-and-gold Japanese dragon and cloud print, red chevron stripes, gold UFC logo and PANTOJA side lettering (ESPN 2025-2026 cutouts). UFC 331 (Sep 2026): black-and-red dragon-print Venum shorts with a gold VENUM waistband and blue-corner gloves.

morphs_if_available.note: Ear targets from the full MakeHuman set. They are not in the shipped assets/embed/mh-manifest.json, so they are listed here and not under morphs.

morphs_unavailable: Cauliflower ear cannot be made with any MakeHuman target: sculpt it or use a normal map on both ears (left worse). No target for the crooked nose bridge, the greying beard or the receding buzz cut beyond forehead-scale-vert.
notes: Confidence: high for the overall look (gaunt angular face, M-shaped receding buzz cut, heavy low straight brows, deep-set dark eyes, broad flattened nose, cauliflower ears, salt-and-pepper short beard with soul patch, left-arm Japanese sleeve, tiny very lean build); medium for exact morph values. Watch for: (1) the sleeve is on his LEFT arm and spills onto the left shoulder and chest; the right arm is bare; (2) the grey in the beard reads at a distance; an all-dark beard makes him look younger; (3) the 2023 Commons photo (longer hair, clean-shaven) is outdated; (4) macro/heightDownM uses heightUpM = 2 * (H - 1.785 m) / 0.875 = -0.31 from research/assets.md; this is an extrapolation below the measured builds, so measure the mesh and nudge until it reads 165 cm.
